# mosadd

> A human OS. Add. — mosadd is an operating system for human communications.
> One MCP server gives any AI agent native DM, persistent channels, ephemeral
> rooms and email across the m* channel family. Open source, Apache-2.0.

mosadd.dev is the developer portal for the mosadd OS toolkit. The toolkit ships
as `@mosadd/*` packages on npm; the headline artifact is `@mosadd/mcp` — a single
MCP server exposing 52 tools across 6 live modules that any agent (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT Apps,
Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, …) can call.

Install: `npx -y @mosadd/mcp@alpha`

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://mosadd.dev/docs/quickstart): install for Claude Code, Cursor, Vercel AI SDK
- [Credentials](https://mosadd.dev/docs/auth): `mosadd login`, MOSADD_* env vars
- [MCP reference](https://mosadd.dev/docs/mcp): all 52 live tools (discover + invoke)
- [Modules](https://mosadd.dev/docs/modules): mDM, mIRC, mROOM, mAIL, mTALK, mKB (alpha); threat-engine (alpha); mCALL (carrier-pending); mIRL (design)
- [SDK adapters](https://mosadd.dev/docs/sdk): Vercel AI, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic
- [Security](https://mosadd.dev/docs/security): threat model + hardening
- [RFCs](https://mosadd.dev/docs/rfcs): protocol RFC index

## Channels (m*)
- mDM — direct messages, end-to-end encrypted, text + voice (12 tools)
- mIRC — persistent channels (20 tools)
- mROOM — ephemeral rooms + no-account join links (9 tools)
- mAIL — email, every user gets <id>@mosadd.com (4 tools)
- mTALK — push-to-talk, half-duplex floor control (5 tools)
- mKB — knowledge base, RAG recall over your own data (2 tools)
- mCALL — outbound/inbound PSTN, ephemeral numbers + vocoder (2 tools, carrier-pending — code shipped, needs a Telnyx/LiveKit trunk)
- mIRL — live-stream after-party (design)
